method: pre-ship check: 5 read-only subagents (Design, Mobile, States, Real user, Launch) x 4 checks = 20 checks; effort medium, Real user high

issues.issue: On Android nothing moves fields above the keyboard. Every KeyboardAvoidingView uses behavior={Platform.OS==='ios'?'padding':undefined}, so it does nothing on Android (coach.tsx:413, transaction.tsx:190, voice.tsx:187, goal.tsx:61, goals.tsx:133, settings.tsx:227, welcome.tsx:214). Screen's automaticallyAdjustKeyboardInsets (components.tsx:178,190) only works on iOS, which affects onboarding and the home price check. The code relies on adjustResize, but RN 0.86 turns on edge-to-edge for targetSdk 35+ (node_modules/react-native/.../views/view/WindowUtil.kt:67 enableEdgeToEdge -> setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)), and in that mode adjustResize does not resize the window. The coach composer is pinned to the bottom of the screen (coach.tsx:452-495), so it sits fully under the keyboard. The bottom save bars in transaction.tsx and goal.tsx, and the save button on voice.tsx, are covered the same way.
issues.evidence: Found by reading the code and RN 0.86 source: KAV with behavior undefined, no react-native-keyboard-controller in package.json, edge-to-edge enabled in WindowUtil.kt:47-67. Not run on an Android device here.
issues.fix: Use behavior='padding' on both platforms; RN sends keyboard events on Android from IME insets (ReactRootView.java:957). Or install react-native-keyboard-controller with `npx expo install` and use its KeyboardAvoidingView / KeyboardAwareScrollView, also in Screen. Test the coach composer, the transaction note + save bar, and voice save on an Android 15+ device.

issues.issue: No Supabase call or Edge Function call has a timeout. On a hanging network (captive portal, weak signal) the launch splash, the coach and the slip scanner can wait forever.
issues.evidence: No AbortController, AbortSignal.timeout or timeout option exists anywhere in src (grep). The launch path awaits loadAll inside activateRepo, and LaunchIntro only leaves when ready (status !== 'loading'), so a hung fetch keeps the user on the intro. React Native's Android OkHttp client has no read timeout by default. coach.ts:9 functions.invoke('coach') keeps busy=true, so the send button stays disabled with typing dots. slips.ts:231 functions.invoke('parse-slip') leaves the scan item 'working' and the banner stuck at 'กำลังอ่าน'. functions-js 2.117 supports a `timeout` option, but it is not used.
issues.fix: Pass { timeout: 30_000 } (or an AbortSignal.timeout) to functions.invoke for coach and parse-slip, and map a timeout to the existing 'network'/'server' messages. Give the client a global fetch with a timeout (createClient(..., { global: { fetch: fetchWithTimeout } }), about 15s) so loadAll fails into the error state instead of hanging.

issues.issue: The settings form takes its starting values once from profile. If profile is null (load failed) or arrives later, the fields show defaults, and pressing บันทึก overwrites the real opening balance and budget on the server.
issues.evidence: Lines 174-177 are useState(profile?.displayName ?? '') and amountToInput(profile?.openingBalanceSatang ?? 0), with the budget empty. Nothing re-syncs them when profile changes. save() at line 213 sends all four fields: openingBalanceSatang 0, runwayFloorSatang 500 and monthlyBudgetSatang null. Home's BudgetCard steers users to /settings exactly when profile is null (index.tsx:286-287). Once the network returns, one tap on บันทึก erases the opening balance (data loss, and the balance becomes wrong).
issues.fix: Block the form (show loading or error with retry) while profile is null, and re-initialise the fields when profile first arrives (key the form on profile?.id, or use an effect that runs once). Send only the fields the user changed.

issues.issue: If the savings goals fail to load, they silently become an empty list. That removes the money set aside in goals from the runway, and a refresh wipes goals that had already loaded.
issues.evidence: r.listGoals().catch(() => [] as SavingsGoal[]) is followed by setGoals(g) with no error flag. useMoney then gets reservedSatang(goals)=0, so the spendable amount and runway days are overstated. Goals.tsx shows the first-goal empty state ('ตั้งกระปุกแรก'), which invites duplicate goals. A pull-to-refresh on a flaky network replaces the good goals list with [].
issues.fix: On goals failure keep the previous goals (setGoals only on success) and set a goalsError flag. Show 'โหลดกระปุกไม่สำเร็จ ลองอีกครั้ง' on Goals and Runway, and mark the runway as possibly overstated, instead of showing the empty state.

issues.issue: If the first load fails (offline at launch, Supabase down), the app still opens the main screens with profile=null and txs=[], so it shows made-up money numbers. The home-screen widget is also overwritten with those zeros.
issues.evidence: The loadAll catch sets loadError, then setStatus('ready') while profile stays null. In _layout.tsx:88-90 signedIn=true and needsOnboarding=false (because !!profile is false), so inApp=true. useMoney then uses opening=0 and floor=50_000, so home MoneyCard (index.tsx:566) shows balance ฿0, '0 วัน' and status below_floor. The greeting is 'สวัสดี ' with no name, and BudgetCard says 'ตั้งงบรายเดือน'. useQuickWidgetSync ((tabs)/_layout.tsx:61-74) saves the snapshot when status==='ready' and pushes balance 0 / below floor to the Android widget. A not-yet-onboarded user who is offline also skips onboarding.
issues.fix: When profile===null after a failed load, show a full-screen 'โหลดข้อมูลไม่ได้' state with a retry button instead of the tabs (for example a loadFailed status in the layout guard). Do not compute or push money numbers or the widget snapshot until a profile has loaded. Better still, cache the last good profile, txs and goals per user in Storage, show them marked as offline, and refresh in the background.

issues.issue: Chart labels are 11pt and 10pt, below the app's 12pt minimum for Thai
issues.evidence: TrendBars axis labels use fontSize={11} (line 101) and the peak amount uses fontSize={10} (line 114). These are Thai weekday/month labels and baht amounts in inkSoft. theme.ts:337 says 'Thai below 12 loses its tone marks'.
issues.fix: Use type.micro.fontSize (12) for both and raise `bottom`/`top` padding in TrendBars to make room.

issues.issue: One summary card shows money in two typefaces
issues.evidence: The total spend is <Money size="display"> (Noto Serif Thai). The per-day average beside it is formatBaht in <T v="h2"> (Anuphan Bold, line 93), and income/net are formatBaht in <T small>. goals.tsx:150 does the same: the reserved total is a T h3 string next to <Money h2> amounts.
issues.fix: Render the amounts with <Money satang size="h2" decimals={false}> (and size="small" for income/net), as DESIGN_SYSTEM section 2 requires.

issues.issue: Android date/time pickers are hand-made boxes that look unlike every other field, and their edge is almost invisible
issues.evidence: pill() draws a Pressable with borderColor theme.line (1.28 to 1.45:1 on surface) instead of inputBox() (lineStrong at 3:1 or more). There is no pressed state. The labels start with the emoji 📅 and 🕒, while every other control uses Ionicons.
issues.fix: Build it from inputBox(theme, { error: warn }) + inputText. Add an Ionicons calendar-outline/time-outline icon and a pressed background (surfaceAlt).

issues.issue: The OTP code box does not use the input style: its edge is invisible until the code is complete, and it has no focus state
issues.evidence: An inline TextInput with borderColor theme.line (1.3:1) when empty, primary only when the code is complete, and no focused state. It sets fontSize 28 with no lineHeight. Every other input uses inputBox(), where lineStrong turns primary on focus.
issues.fix: Use inputBox(theme, { focused, error }) with an onFocus/onBlur state, and keep only the large serif digits and letterSpacing as an override.

issues.issue: Hero card text is below 4.5:1 at the top of the gradient in the Golden Amber and Sunset Copper light themes
issues.evidence: Text sits at the top-left of a heroTop to heroDeep gradient. Contrast there: heroInkSoft 'เงินพอใช้อีก' 4.06 (amber light) and 4.03 (sunset light); heroIncome status 3.94 (amber light); hard-coded '#FFB4A8' 'bad' status 3.31 to 4.4 (amber/sunset/rose). TC-78 (src/ui/__tests__/theme.test.ts:51) only checks heroInkSoft on `hero` (the middle stop), not on heroTop. The same pattern is in runway.tsx:103/131 and achievements.tsx:77.
issues.fix: Darken heroTop (hero[0]) for amber (#8C5E14) and sunset (#A5471F), or lighten their heroInkSoft. Add heroInkSoft, heroIncome and a new heroCritical token on heroTop to TC-78.
issues.fix_note: heroInkSoft/heroIncome/heroCritical ถูกยกให้อ่านได้บน heroTop; heroTop ของ amber/sunset เข้มขึ้น; TC-78 ตรวจบน heroTop แล้ว

issues.issue: Runway slider thumb and track are hard to see in every light theme
issues.evidence: The thumb is heroAccent with a 3pt `surface` border on a white Card: 1.45 to 2.1:1 in all 9 light themes. The track (surfaceAlt) is 1.18:1 and the filled part (accent) 2.6 to 3.1:1. Only the shadow shows where the thumb is. On the web it is focusable but has no focus style.
issues.fix: In light mode use theme.accentInk (or primary) for the thumb and a lineStrong border. Give the track a lineStrong-level colour. Add a focus ring (borderColor primary) while focused on the web.

issues.issue: Selected state uses a gold border that is below 3:1 and does not match the primary-colour selection used elsewhere
issues.evidence: SkinCard picked: borderColor theme.accent (2pt). goal.tsx:88 emoji picker selected: accent border on accentSoft. accent on surface is 2.6:1 (forest light) and 2.4 to 3.1 in the other light themes; unselected uses `line` (1.3:1). Chip, Segmented, the tab pill and SpendCalendar all show selection in primary.
issues.fix: Use theme.primary (2pt) and alpha(primary) fill for selection, as Chip does, or at least accentInk for the border.

issues.issue: Several tappable rows give no feedback when pressed, unlike TxRow and the add sheet
issues.evidence: LinkRow (settings.tsx:64), AttentionRow and the 'ตั้งงบรายเดือน' row (index.tsx:161, 286), the older-news rows (whatsnew.tsx:189), the goal emoji tiles (goal.tsx:74) and the Android date pill (transaction.tsx:167) all use a plain style object. TxRow uses opacity 0.6, the add sheet's Option uses a surfaceAlt background, and BudgetCard uses opacity 0.85.
issues.fix: Make style a function of ({ pressed }) and use one shared treatment (for example surfaceAlt background or opacity 0.7), ideally from a small PressableRow in components.tsx.

issues.issue: Email confirm and reset links use the mindpay:// scheme, which the original MindPay app (com.socratesandskeletons.mindpay, scheme 'mindpay' on main) also registers. On a phone with both apps installed, the link can open the old app or show a chooser, so the v2 sign-up or reset never finishes.
issues.evidence: return Linking.createURL('/', { scheme: 'mindpay' }); app.json:101 declares scheme ['mindpay','mindpay-v2']; origin/main:app.json:82 "scheme": "mindpay"
issues.fix: Send auth links with scheme 'mindpay-v2', add mindpay-v2://** to the Supabase Auth redirect allow-list, and drop 'mindpay' from the v2 app.json scheme list.
issues.owner_note: ต้องให้ทีมเพิ่ม mindpay-v2://** ใน Supabase Auth → URL Configuration → Redirect URLs ก่อน แล้วค่อยเปลี่ยน scheme ใน src/domain/authLinks.ts (Claude ไม่แก้การตั้งค่า auth เอง)

issues.issue: The release APK asks for more than the app uses. The generated manifest (expo config --type introspect) includes SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW ('display over other apps') and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. The app never draws over other apps and never saves to the gallery (savePhotosPermission false).
issues.evidence: Final uses-permission: INTERNET, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, VIBRATE, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, RECORD_AUDIO. blockedPermissions removes only CAMERA, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.
issues.fix: Add "android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW" and "android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" to android.blockedPermissions.

issues.issue: The v2 APK checks for EAS updates on the same project and 'production' channel as the original app, with runtimeVersion policy appVersion. The only EAS Update workflow publishes from branch main. If main's app.json version is ever bumped to 2.0.0 (eas-update.yml:9-11 tells maintainers to bump it), installed 'MindPay ใหม่' apps will download the old app's JS bundle. In the meantime, v2 never receives OTA fixes.
issues.evidence: app.json updates.url u.expo.dev/eb06a5c2…, requestHeaders expo-channel-name 'production', version 2.0.0. origin/main:app.json uses the same projectId and channel with version 1.0.0. eas-update.yml triggers on branches: [main].
issues.fix: Give v2 its own channel (e.g. expo-channel-name 'production-v2'), and either add a v2 EAS Update job that publishes to it or set updates.enabled=false until one exists.

issues.issue: A user-facing error tells students about server internals (secret name GEMINI_API_KEY and the Supabase dashboard path). The same text appears in the coach error at src/services/coach.ts:15.
issues.evidence: not_configured: 'ระบบอ่านสลิปยังไม่พร้อม: ผู้ดูแลต้องใส่ GEMINI_API_KEY ใน Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets (หรือ key ที่ใส่ไว้ใช้ไม่ได้)'. The strings are compiled into the web bundle (dist/_expo/static/js/web/index-a9bf…js contains GEMINI_API_KEY twice).
issues.fix: Replace both with plain Thai, e.g. 'ระบบอ่านสลิปยังไม่พร้อมใช้งาน ลองใหม่ภายหลัง' / 'โค้ช AI ยังไม่พร้อมตอนนี้ ลองใหม่ภายหลัง'. Keep the admin detail only in the Edge Function logs.

issues.issue: Auth errors expose internals and a developer to-do to users. Line 95 also says 'ระบบอีเมลแบบฟรีส่งได้ชั่วโมงละ 2 ฉบับ', and line 121 falls back to the raw English Supabase message in brackets.
issues.evidence: '(อีเมลฟรีของ Supabase ส่งได้เฉพาะอีเมลของทีมผู้พัฒนา) แจ้งผู้ดูแลให้ปิด Confirm email หรือตั้งค่า SMTP'; line 121: `ทำรายการไม่สำเร็จ (${error.message})`
issues.fix: Use neutral Thai text, e.g. 'ส่งอีเมลยืนยันไม่ได้ตอนนี้ ลองใหม่ภายหลัง' and 'ส่งอีเมลบ่อยเกินไป รอสักพักแล้วลองใหม่'. Drop the raw error.message from the fallback and log it instead.

issues.issue: The sign-up copy says confirmation emails come from 'Supabase Auth', which is Supabase's built-in test mailer. Together with the auth.ts:95/101 handling, it suggests that launch relies on the default SMTP. That mailer sends only to the project team's addresses and allows about 2 emails per hour, so real students may never get a code if 'Confirm email' is on. This could not be checked against the live project.
issues.evidence: <T v="micro">ไม่เจออีเมล? ดูในจดหมายขยะ/Spam ผู้ส่งคือ Supabase Auth</T>
issues.fix: Before launch, either set up custom SMTP with a MindPay sender name, or confirm that 'Confirm email' is off. Then change the line to name the real sender, e.g. 'ผู้ส่งคือ MindPay'.
issues.owner_note: ต้องให้ทีมตั้ง Custom SMTP และตัดสินใจเรื่อง Confirm email ใน Supabase Auth (Claude ไม่แก้การตั้งค่า auth เอง)

issues.issue: On iOS, transaction, voice, goal and whatsnew open as page sheets (presentation:'modal' in _layout.tsx:111-117). RN's KeyboardAvoidingView works out the overlap from its onLayout frame, which is relative to its parent, and compares it with the keyboard's screenY (KeyboardAvoidingView.js:98-111). Inside a page sheet that starts about 50-60pt below the top of the screen, the padding comes out short by that offset. Part of the bottom save bar (transaction.tsx:362) and the voice save button stay under the keyboard.
issues.evidence: Code: KAV without keyboardVerticalOffset inside modal screens. KeyboardAvoidingView.js:98 uses this._frame from onLayout.
issues.fix: Pass keyboardVerticalOffset equal to the sheet's top offset (measure it with measureInWindow, or use headerHeight/useSafeAreaFrame). Or use react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardAvoidingView, which measures in window coordinates.

issues.issue: The web/PWA build for iPhone has no viewport-fit=cover in its viewport meta. Without it, iOS reports env(safe-area-inset-bottom) as 0, so react-native-safe-area-context gives insets.bottom=0 in the home-screen app. The tab bar (_layout.tsx:163 paddingBottom: insets.bottom), the add sheet (add.tsx:124), ConfirmSheet, and the bottom save bars then sit under the home indicator on Face ID iPhones, where tab labels and the swipe-home gesture compete.
issues.evidence: dist/index.html: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no">. web-home-screen.mjs adds apple-mobile-web-app tags but no viewport-fit.
issues.fix: Have web-home-screen.mjs rewrite the viewport meta to 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover' (or add src/app/+html.tsx with it). Keep status-bar-style 'default' so the top stays below the status bar, then check the tab bar padding in an iPhone home-screen install.

issues.issue: The 'ทิ้งสิ่งที่แก้ไว้?' discard confirmation only appears from the on-screen ✕ (close = dirty ? setAskDiscard : goBack). Android hardware back, iOS swipe-down on the page sheet and web browser back all close the form without asking, so a typed or edited transaction (or a slip draft being checked) is lost.
issues.evidence: No usePreventRemove/beforeRemove/gestureEnabled anywhere in src/app (grep). Only transaction.tsx:53 guards ✕.
issues.fix: In transaction.tsx call usePreventRemove(dirty && !busy, ({data}) => { pending.current = data.action; setAskDiscard(true); }) from @react-navigation/native (re-exported by expo-router). On confirm, dispatch the pending action. Also set gestureEnabled:false while dirty.

issues.issue: With email confirmation on, a user who leaves or reloads at step 2 (the 6-digit code screen) cannot get back to it. Signing in shows 'ยังไม่ได้ยืนยันอีเมล' with 'ส่งอีเมลยืนยันอีกครั้ง'. That button only shows 'ส่งอีเมลใหม่ไปที่ … แล้ว' and opens no code field, so the code from the email cannot be typed anywhere. The only way through is the link in the email.
issues.evidence: confirmEmail=true: sign up as ดาว, reach 'ยืนยันอีเมล', reload, sign in with the same email and password, tap 'ส่งอีเมลยืนยันอีกครั้ง'. The result is an info box and no #otp field. Screenshots: r1b-B-reload-at-code.png, r1b-B-signin-unconfirmed.png, r1b-B-after-resend.png
issues.fix: In resend(..., 'confirm') from the sign-in notice, also call setSent({ email, kind: 'confirm', name }) so the same code screen as after sign-up opens (step 2 of 3). Or show the code field right under the 'ยังไม่ได้ยืนยันอีเมล' notice.

issues.issue: In demo mode, the first option in the (+) sheet ('เลือกสลิปจากแกลเลอรี') opens a screen that only says 'โหมดทดลองยังอ่านสลิปไม่ได้ … เข้าสู่ระบบด้วยบัญชีจริง', with no button to do so. Nowhere in the demo is there a 'สมัคร/เข้าสู่ระบบ' action. The only way to a real account is Settings, then the red 'ออกจากโหมดทดลอง' at the very bottom, then 'ออกและล้างข้อมูลตัวอย่าง', which reads like a destructive action rather than 'create my account'.
issues.evidence: Welcome, 'ลองใช้ด้วยข้อมูลตัวอย่าง', (+), 'เลือกสลิปจากแกลเลอรี': the scan screen shows only the message and an X. Screenshot: crawl-scan.png. The demo home has only a small 'ทดลอง' pill (r1-08-demo-home.png). The demo settings bottom row is 'ออกจากโหมดทดลอง' (r1-09-demo-settings.png). The coach demo message (coach.tsx:141) has no action either.
issues.fix: Add a 'สมัครบัญชีจริง / เข้าสู่ระบบ' button under the demo message on scan.tsx and in the coach demo error. Also add a one-line banner or tap target on the 'ทดลอง' pill on home. Each of these should call signOut() (demo) and open welcome on the สมัครสมาชิก tab. In the (+) sheet in demo, label the slip option 'ต้องใช้บัญชีจริง'.
issues.fix_note: ปุ่ม "สมัครบัญชีจริง" (DemoUpgrade) บนหน้าสแกน, ฟองโค้ช และป้ายทดลองบนหน้าหลัก; แผ่น + บอก "ต้องใช้บัญชีจริง"

issues.issue: Quick Access 'วันนี้ใช้ไป ฿X' (a11y label '… ดูรายการวันนี้') just navigates to /transactions and keeps whatever filter, category, search or calendar day the user last left there. Today's spending may then not be shown at all.
issues.evidence: Demo: add an expense of ฿60 'ชาไข่มุกวันนี้', go to the รายการ tab, choose 'รายรับ', go to หน้าหลัก, tap 'วันนี้ใช้ไป ฿60'. The list shows only incomes from 1 ต.ค., 15 ก.ย. and so on. Today's ฿60 item is not visible and the รายรับ tab is still selected. Screenshot: rq-quick-access-stale-filter.png
issues.fix: Navigate with a param, e.g. router.navigate({ pathname: '/transactions', params: { day: today } }). In transactions.tsx, read useLocalSearchParams and, when the param is present, reset kind and category to all, clear the search and select today (with 'ดูทุกวัน' to leave). Or change the label so it doesn't promise today's list.

issues.issue: Money fields in Settings switch from '3,000' to '3000' when focused. When a keyboard user Tabs into the field, the browser selects '3,000', the re-render replaces it, the selection is lost and the caret goes to the end, so the new number is added to the old one. Saving then stores a balance 10,000 times too big without any check or warning.
issues.evidence: In a real account (fake backend) with opening 3,000: Settings, click ชื่อเล่น, press Tab into 'ยอดเงินตอนเริ่มใช้', type 3200. The field reads 30003200 (selection on focus was [4,4]). With page.fill the same happens: typing 2900 and pressing บันทึก made home show 'ยอดคงเหลือ ฿30,002,800' and 'เงินพอใช้อีก 365 วัน'. Screenshots: rf2-tab-into-opening.png, rf-opening-balance-trap.png
issues.fix: Keep the field value the same whether focused or not (show grouping only in a separate label), or select all on focus after the value switches (onFocus: setFocused(true) then requestAnimationFrame(() => input.setSelection(0, len))). Also add a sanity check in save(): confirm when the opening balance, reserve or budget changes by more than about 10× or goes above ฿1,000,000.

issues.issue: Settings mixes instant settings (theme, mode, sound switch, which save on tap) with money fields that need 'บันทึก' in the middle of the page. Edits to the name, balance, reserve or budget are thrown away without a word when the user taps กลับ. The transaction form asks 'ทิ้งสิ่งที่แก้ไว้?' in the same situation.
issues.evidence: Real account: Settings, type 7000 in 'งบใช้จ่ายต่อเดือน' (saved value 5,000), tap กลับ. No dialog appears and the app goes home. Reopening Settings shows budget 5,000. Screenshots: r4b-settings-after-change.png, r4b-settings-after-reload.png (log: 'left settings with unsaved budget … dialog? 0 / budget now 5,000')
issues.fix: Track dirty state (compare against the profile values) and pass onBack to StackHeader to show the same ConfirmSheet 'ทิ้งสิ่งที่แก้ไว้?'. Or auto-save valid money fields on blur, like the theme options.

issues.issue: 'ดึงสลิปวันนี้' gives no result when nothing new is found, and does nothing at all when a scan is already running. The user taps it and sees nothing happen, or only a brief flash on Home.
issues.evidence: add.tsx:102 calls auto.grantAndRun().catch(() => {}) and closes the sheet. run() returns early without feedback when running.current or scanLock.manual is set (line 129). When the run finds nothing new it does setState(IDLE) ('stay quiet'). The banner only exists on Home, so starting it from another tab shows nothing.
issues.fix: Give run() a `manual` flag. For a user-started pull, end in a 'done' state such as 'ไม่พบสลิปใหม่ของวันนี้' (or a toast) instead of IDLE, and show a toast when a scan is already running.

issues.issue: The home error card shows the raw technical error text from Supabase or fetch, for example 'TypeError: Network request failed' or 'JWT expired'. An expired session gets no 'sign in again' path.
issues.evidence: AppProvider.tsx:153 does setLoadError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : ...). That raw text is shown as the AttentionRow sub (sub={loadError}). PostgrestError messages are English and technical, and a 401 (JWT expired) only offers 'ลองอีกครั้ง', which fails again.
issues.fix: Map errors to Thai messages in the provider, like authErrorMessage: network gives 'ไม่มีอินเทอร์เน็ต ลองอีกครั้ง', PGRST301/401/JWT gives 'เซสชันหมดอายุ' plus a sign-in action (signOut then welcome), and anything else gets a generic message. Never put e.message in the UI.

issues.issue: A failed coach question is lost: the input is cleared before the call and the error bubble has no retry. Also, when profile is null, quick chips and send silently do nothing.
issues.evidence: send() calls setInput('') before askCoach. The catch only appends an error message, with no retry action and no restore of q. Line 116, `if (!q || busy || !profile) return;`, exits silently with no feedback, so tapping a starter chip after a failed load does nothing.
issues.fix: Keep the question in the error message and add a 'ถามอีกครั้ง' button on error bubbles that calls send(q), or restore the input on failure. When profile is null, show a notice ('ยังโหลดข้อมูลไม่ได้') instead of returning silently.

issues.issue: A failed save after the AI has already read a slip (network drop, expired session, RLS error) is reported as 'this photo failed', and the scan carries on. Every following photo uses up another AI read and then fails to save.
issues.evidence: processSlip.ts:108-110 rethrows any non-duplicate repo.insert error as a plain Error (not SlipReaderError). In the manual loop it falls into the per-item branch: status 'failed' with 'เกิดข้อผิดพลาดกับรูปนี้', and the loop continues. In AutoScanProvider.tsx:216-219 code===null takes the per-photo failure branch, which does not push to `unreadable`, so the run goes through the whole batch and each photo burns an AI-quota read. Photos reach MAX_AUTO_ATTEMPTS and are dropped from auto-scan.
issues.fix: In processSlipImage, wrap insert errors in a SlipReaderError: 'network' for fetch failures and 'unauthorized' for a 401 or JWT error. That way both loops pause the whole run with the right message and retry the photo later, without marking it failed or counting an attempt.

issues.issue: Opening the app offline with an expired access token (the usual case after more than an hour away) shows the Welcome/sign-in screen as if the user were signed out, with no offline message.
issues.evidence: auth-js __loadSession returns {session:null, error:AuthRetryableFetchError} when the refresh fails on the network and the stored token has expired. Line 295 ignores `error` and line 300 then calls setStatus('signedOut'). The comment at 308-309 admits the session only comes back later through TOKEN_REFRESHED. Meanwhile the user sees the sign-in form, and trying to sign in only gives a network error.
issues.fix: Check `error` from getSession. If it is a retryable fetch error (or isAuthRetryableFetchError) and a stored session exists, keep the user in an 'offline / reconnecting' state with a retry button (or cached data) instead of signedOut.

issues.issue: The 'money runs out' red on the hero is hard-coded and repeated with two different values
issues.evidence: index.tsx:199 and runway.tsx:73 use '#FFB4A8'; RunwayRail.tsx:56 uses '#FF9A8F' for the same meaning. Neither is a theme token, and neither changes with the colour theme (3.3:1 on amber light heroTop).
issues.fix: Add a heroCritical token to Theme (per theme, checked in TC-78) and use it in all three places.

issues.issue: The streak flame colour is hard-coded and is below 3:1 on the light page background
issues.evidence: color={today ? '#E07B2E' : theme.inkSoft}. Contrast with bg is 2.69 to 2.79 in all 9 light themes. achievements.tsx:73 and recap.tsx:209 use another value, '#F29E4C'.
issues.fix: Use theme.watch (or a new streak token that is 3:1 or more on bg) for the filled flame, and one value everywhere.

issues.issue: Hero text colours are typed as hex instead of using the hero tokens
issues.evidence: UpdateBanner uses color="#F4F1E6" on theme.hero (= heroInk). welcome.tsx:269 uses '#E8E1CC' for the value chips. components.tsx:305 (Button onDark) and :554 (Badge onDark) also hard-code '#F4F1E6' and other values. A change to heroInk or heroInkSoft will not reach them.
issues.fix: Use theme.heroInk / theme.heroInkSoft, and alpha(theme.heroInk, x) for the translucent fills.

issues.issue: Toast text sets fontSize without lineHeight and does not use the type scale
issues.evidence: Text style { fontFamily: sansMedium, fontSize: 14 } for the message and { sansBold, fontSize: 14 } for the action (line 93), with no lineHeight. The design system forbids fontSize without lineHeight because Thai marks above and below get clipped.
issues.fix: Spread type.small ({fontSize:14, lineHeight:22}) into both styles, or use <T v="small">.

issues.issue: The runway day count changes size between the home card and the runway screen it opens
issues.evidence: Home uses <T v="display" style={{ fontSize: 56, lineHeight: 64 }}>, outside the scale. runway.tsx:107 shows the same number as plain display (38/52). The home figures (lines 262/265) also override Money to 17/26, which is just size="h3".
issues.fix: Add a `hero` step to the type scale (56/64) and use it on both screens. Use <Money size="h3"> for the two small figures.

issues.issue: The type scale in the design doc does not match the code
issues.evidence: The doc says h1 26/38, small 13/20, micro 11/16, and label '11/16 ตัวหนา ระยะห่างตัวอักษรกว้าง'. theme.ts:330 has h1 24/34, small 14/22, micro 12/18, and components.tsx:83 says labels must have no letter spacing (Thai).
issues.fix: Update the table in section 2 to the values in theme.ts. State that label = micro semibold, no letterSpacing.

issues.issue: Scan and voice screens build their own header instead of using StackHeader
issues.evidence: scan.tsx:89 and voice.tsx:182 use a Row with IconButton, T h3 and HeaderDecor. Paddings differ (no paddingBottom), the title is not marked accessibilityRole="header" and has no numberOfLines. All other pushed screens use StackHeader.
issues.fix: Replace with <StackHeader title="สแกนสลิป" close /> and <StackHeader title="พูดจดรายการ" close />.

issues.issue: The same transaction rows have different padding and dividers on different screens
issues.evidence: Transactions list: paddingHorizontal space.md and dividers inset 52. Home recent list (index.tsx:591): paddingHorizontal space.lg and full-width dividers. Drafts and scan (drafts.tsx:61, scan.tsx:223): Card padding lg, full-width dividers.
issues.fix: Add one TxList/ListCard wrapper in src/ui (surface, radius.lg, paddingHorizontal space.lg, divider inset 40+space.md) and use it on all four screens.

issues.issue: Section headings are rebuilt by hand on most screens, so the gaps and links differ
issues.evidence: SectionHead (with marginTop sm, a 44pt link and a chevron) is used only on stats.tsx:102. Home 'รายการล่าสุด' rebuilds it inline. runway, achievements, skins (its own Section), drafts, coach and settings Group each use their own h3 + Row with different spacing. components.tsx:254 also still exports an older SectionTitle with a primary-colour link.
issues.fix: Use SectionHead everywhere a h3 heading with an optional right-side link appears, and remove SectionTitle.

issues.issue: Icon tiles and rows use radius values that are not tokens and differ between screens
issues.evidence: Category/icon tiles: radius 12 (TxRow.tsx:35, index.tsx:168, voice.tsx:297), 14 (add.tsx:45, runway.tsx:284), 10 (settings.tsx:54), 9 (charts.tsx:268). add.tsx:41 uses borderRadius 16 and :121 uses 28 (should be radius.xl).
issues.fix: Pick one tile radius (radius.md = 14, or add radius.tile) and use radius.* everywhere.

issues.issue: Mission and skin cards have a hairline outline, while Card has no outline
issues.evidence: MissionCard: borderWidth hairline, borderColor line, with the comment 'Like Card: a hairline'. Card (components.tsx:237) is now borderWidth 0. SkinCard (skins.tsx:368) and SlipCopy (SlipCopy.tsx:50, 1pt line) also use outlines.
issues.fix: Remove the hairline (borderWidth 0 unless done/picked) so these match Card.

issues.issue: Tab titles sit at different heights, so the title jumps when switching tabs
issues.evidence: Transactions header paddingTop space.md (12). Stats (stats.tsx:51) and Coach (coach.tsx:417) use space.sm (8), as DESIGN_SYSTEM section 4 specifies.
issues.fix: Use paddingTop: space.sm in transactions.tsx:88.

issues.issue: Gold icons use `accent` where the design system calls for accentInk, so they are faint in light mode
issues.evidence: SentCard mail/key icon: theme.accent on accentSoft is 2.1 to 2.5:1. AuthNotice.tsx:247 key icon is accent on surface (2.6:1). Other gold icons on light surfaces (stats.tsx:141, runway.tsx:285) correctly use accentInk.
issues.fix: Use theme.accentInk for both icons.

issues.issue: Row chevrons use inkFaint (below 3:1 in some light themes) on some screens and inkSoft on others
issues.evidence: inkFaint on surface: forest 2.95, sapphire 2.90, amber 2.77. Used at transactions.tsx:195, add.tsx:56, runway.tsx:292, settings.tsx:69 and SlipCopy.tsx:59. Home rows (index.tsx:181, 299) use inkSoft.
issues.fix: Use theme.inkSoft for every chevron and affordance icon.

issues.issue: The calendar's month arrows only look disabled at the first/last month; screen readers are not told
issues.evidence: IconButton gets color theme.line and onPress={() => onPrev?.()}. It is still pressable, has no aria-disabled, and gives the same pressed background.
issues.fix: Add a `disabled` prop to IconButton (disabled + aria-disabled + no pressed bg) and pass disabled={!onPrev} / {!onNext}.

issues.issue: The search box has no visible edge until it is focused
issues.evidence: inputBox is overridden with backgroundColor surfaceAlt and borderColor surfaceAlt on the bg page. The fill contrast against bg is 1.07 to 1.22 in all 18 theme variants, so only the icon and placeholder show it is a field.
issues.fix: Keep the pill but use borderColor theme.lineStrong when not focused (as inputBox does), or put it on `surface`.

issues.issue: The first screen says what the app does but not who it is for. The title shows 'MindPay' while the installed app is named 'MindPay ใหม่', and the web <title> is the bare name. The coach prompt (supabase/functions/coach/index.ts:12) defines the audience as students and first-jobbers, but users never see that.
issues.evidence: <T v="display">MindPay</T> / 'รู้ก่อนจ่าย เห็นว่าเงินจะอยู่ได้อีกกี่วัน'
issues.fix: Make the tagline one sentence that names the audience, e.g. 'แอปจดเงินสำหรับนักศึกษา อ่านสลิปให้เอง และบอกว่าเงินพอใช้ถึงวันไหน'. Optionally use 'MindPay ใหม่ · <tagline>' as the web <title>.

issues.issue: The first-run hint uses the unexplained English term 'Money Runway' in otherwise Thai copy. It is repeated in settings.tsx:264.
issues.evidence: hint="Money Runway จะนับวันจนเงินเหลือเท่านี้ ค่าเริ่มต้น ฿500"
issues.fix: Use the Thai wording the rest of the app uses, e.g. 'แอปจะนับว่าเงินพอใช้กี่วัน จนเหลือเท่านี้ ค่าเริ่มต้น ฿500'.

issues.issue: 'มีอะไรใหม่' hard-codes promotions that end soon ('แจกชุดผู้บุกเบิกถึง 31 ต.ค.'; Halloween theme 'ถึง 2 พ.ย.' at line 53). After those dates the screen still advertises them to every new user.
issues.evidence: body: '… ตอนนี้แจกชุดผู้บุกเบิกถึง 31 ต.ค.' / '… (ถึง 2 พ.ย.)'
issues.fix: Hide or reword the entries after their end dates, using the same date windows as src/domain/skins.ts and halloween.ts, or remove the dates from the copy.
issues.fix_note: วันที่ของโปรฯ มาจากช่วงจริงใน skins.ts/halloween.ts และหายเองเมื่อหมดเวลา

issues.issue: The web page is declared as English and has no description: the exported index.html keeps Expo's <html lang="en"> and has no <meta name="description">. For an all-Thai app, Chrome may offer to 'translate from English', screen readers use the wrong voice, and link previews show no summary.
issues.evidence: dist/index.html:2 <html lang="en">; no description meta (the manifest has one: 'เพื่อนการเงินที่อ่านสลิปและบอกว่าเงินพอถึงวันไหน').
issues.fix: In web-home-screen.mjs, replace '<html lang="en">' with '<html lang="th">' and add <meta name="description" content="…"> with the manifest description to the injected tags.

issues.issue: The privacy text names only Google Gemini as the AI that reads slips. parse-slip/_shared/common.ts sends slip images (and coach data) to Anthropic Claude whenever ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, and Claude is preferred when both keys exist (common.ts:86-88). If the server has that key, the privacy text is wrong.
issues.evidence: '…จะถูกส่งให้ AI (Google Gemini) อ่าน…' vs common.ts callClaude → https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
issues.fix: Either keep the server Gemini-only (set AI_PROVIDER=gemini and do not set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), or change the text to 'AI (Google Gemini หรือ Anthropic Claude)'.

issues.issue: In the voice confirm list each parsed item's title is limited to 1 line. At 360px the amount (h3 with decimals), the รายรับ/รายจ่าย toggle and the ✕ leave about 90px, so a title like 'ค่าเทอมมหาวิทยาลัยภาคเรียนที่สอง' shows only as 'ค่าเทอมม...'. This is the screen where the user checks what will be saved.
issues.evidence: screenshot voice-rows-360.png
issues.fix: Use numberOfLines={2} on the title (or no limit), or put the amount under the title on narrow widths. Money size 'body' with decimals='auto' would also free space.

issues.issue: The settings number/name inputs (ชื่อเล่น, ยอดเงินตอนเริ่ม, เงินสำรอง, งบ) are about 36pt tall TextInputs (paddingVertical 8) inside a 132pt box with no minHeight. They are below 44pt, and tapping the box padding does not focus the field.
issues.evidence: scan.json 360x640/settings: inputs 110x36. settings.tsx:130-143
issues.fix: Add minHeight: 44 to the box and paddingVertical 12 (inputText default) to the input. Or make the box a Pressable that focuses the input ref.

issues.issue: ToggleRow is not tappable; only the Switch is. On web/PWA (iPhone users) the RN-web Switch is 40x20px, so 'เสียงน้องกล้า' and the auto-scan toggle have tiny targets.
issues.evidence: scan.json 360x640/settings: 'เสียงน้องกล้า' 40x20
issues.fix: Make the whole ToggleRow a Pressable with accessibilityRole='switch' and aria-checked that calls onValueChange(!value), and hide the inner Switch from accessibility.

issues.issue: In the tab bar Quick Access capsule, the (+) (hitSlop 6) and 'วันนี้ใช้ไป' (hitSlop 8, :221) are only 8pt apart (gap :194). Their touch areas overlap by about 6pt, and the later sibling (the transactions link) wins, so a slightly-right tap on (+) opens the list instead of the add sheet.
issues.evidence: _layout.tsx:194 gap 8, :207 hitSlop 6, :221 hitSlop 8. Measured rects: (+) 117-159, today 167-235 at 360px
issues.fix: Use hitSlop {top,bottom} only on the today pressable (or {left:0}), or increase the gap to 14+.

issues.issue: There is no +not-found route. A bad link or old bookmark on the web (or an unknown mindpay-v2:// path) shows expo-router's black English 'Unmatched Route' page with a 'Sitemap' link and a URL missing the base path. 'Go back' does reach home, so the user is not trapped.
issues.evidence: screenshot nav-nope.png (/Socrates-and-Skeletons-/nope)
issues.fix: Add src/app/+not-found.tsx that redirects to '/' (or shows a Thai message with a home button).

issues.issue: The home money card shows the balance rounded to whole baht, so ฿3,500.50 appears as '฿3,501': more money than the user has. The same balance reads ฿3,500.50 in the card's a11y label and in Settings.
issues.evidence: Onboarding with balance '3,500.50': the home card shows ยอดคงเหลือ ฿3,501 while its aria-label says ฿3,500.50. Screenshot: r1-07-home.png
issues.fix: Floor instead of round for whole-baht balance display (Math.floor(satang/100)*100 before formatting), or show satang when the balance is not a whole baht.
issues.fix_note: ยอดคงเหลือบนการ์ดแสดงสตางค์เมื่อไม่ใช่บาทเต็ม (ไม่ปัดขึ้นอีก)

issues.issue: When every photo failed to read, the finished scan says 'อ่านเสร็จแล้ว ไม่พบสลิปใหม่' and gives no way to retry the failed photos.
issues.evidence: The header depends only on recorded.length. counts.failed is shown just as a small micro text ('อ่านไม่ได้ N'). The only action is 'สแกนอีกครั้ง', which searches the gallery again.
issues.fix: When counts.failed > 0, say 'อ่านไม่ได้ N รูป' in the header and add 'ลองรูปที่อ่านไม่ได้อีกครั้ง', which re-queues the failed items (or points to 'เลือกรูปเอง').

issues.issue: Opening /transaction with an id that is not in the loaded list (deleted on another device, older than the 13-month window, opened before the data loads) silently shows a blank new-transaction form.
issues.evidence: existing = txs.find(...) is undefined, so the screen titles itself 'จดรายการ' and all state is taken once from undefined. Saving creates a new row instead of telling the user the item is gone.
issues.fix: If an id param is given but no match exists, show 'ไม่พบรายการนี้ (อาจถูกลบแล้ว)' with a back button instead of the empty form.
